card.name: Case counts and the 'b' in Morbidity
card.fires_on: Two settings: the letter 'b' in 'Morbidity' in the heading 'Mortality and Coronary Heart Disease Morbidity', and words like 'cases' or 'new' right after a number of disease occurrences.

modes.description: The word 'cases' or 'new' after a number or 'number of' when describing how many people have a disease.
modes.example: Forty-one percent of the world's population live in areas where malaria is transmitted, with 350-500 million<< cases>> each year.

card.plain: It lights up on the spelling of 'Morbidity' in one label heading and on the word 'cases' when counting disease in a population.
